digest.component_or_area: janitor approval phase - RP-02 through RP-06 derisk recovery
propositions: Five approved recovery proposals (RP-02 through RP-06) from a lossy 2026-08-16 janitor plan require evidence-backed, architecture-preserving decision briefs before becoming implementation stories, reducing ambiguity without premature code changes.

RP-02 transaction semantics must resolve exact-match retirement recovery: tombstone-first/live-second ordering with no-op repeat and safety-abort on ambiguity or replacement failure, as an approved behavior delta from prior identity-reloading.

RP-03 failure handling requires singular retry ownership (3 physical attempts, 15s cumulative sleep per logical operation) with scoped three-consecutive finite-pass fuse, explicit Jira rate/auth/config scope separation, and write-ahead `commit_unknown` re-observation when key persistence fails after Jira create succeeds.

RP-04 operation snapshot with resolved CLI > environment > project > user > default precedence, fail-closed malformed-config behavior, and removal of Cloud's adapter-local fallback is architecture-complete and implementation-ready.

RP-05 normalizes help routing before config/store/handler composition, with canonical package-data help for every visible top-level command, parity-first alias handling preserving bridge compatibility, and exactly one stdlib lazy registry without DI/plugin discovery.

RP-06 unified effective-policy discovery combines RP-02 coherent binding state with RP-03 typed lifecycle intents and RP-04 resolved operation authority into immutable snapshots, with Option B failure policy (preserve successes, continue independent units, skip blocked units, record gaps, allow explicit `--retry` only for missing calls with fresh budget).
